note: THE source file: the priority of every city and the number of trees we aim for there. Written 2026-08-12 at Hidde's request ('ik zou graag een bron bestand zien met prioriteit van 100 steden en voor welk getal aan bomen we streven'). Everything else is generated FROM this file and cannot disagree with it: CITY_QUEUE.md is the readable rendering, data/city-list.json is the inventory the site and scripts already read. Regenerate both with python3 scripts/city_queue.py.

fields.rank: position in the one queue; null means unscored backlog, worked only after the 100
fields.score: demand times our own realised yield, decided in session (see CITY_QUEUE.md)
fields.demand: English Wikipedia pageviews, the demand proxy
fields.basis: how the score was arrived at: measured, published-never-ranked, predicted
fields.target: trees we aim for. 25 where anything cheap is within reach, none below that; past 25 is a deepening decision with Hidde, never a run's target
fields.supply: register trees within 5 km plus leads already ready to write
fields.trees/photos/walks: measured from data/cities on every regeneration, never hand-kept

cities.why_pooled: Hidde's own ask, 2026-08-17. Sacred banyans in temple precincts are the whole supply story here: the Bunut Bolong with a road through its roots, the Monkey Forest banyans at Ubud, the kepuh and waringin planted at village temples across the island. Temple ground is exactly the sacred-ground pattern the search doctrine says to look at first.
Small, hugely visited, and it protects trees by law: the Bidnija olives are claimed as Roman-era and there is a national tree-protection framework to check for data.
Same imported Balears register as Menorca. Check the file before scouting anything.
Cheap by inheritance: MASAF covers it and Campania is the one Italian region publishing per-tree cards WITH an age estimate, which is what made Caserta and Naples inexpensive.
Same Campania inheritance as Capri, plus La Mortella, one of the most important gardens in the Mediterranean, which keeps its own records.
The Balears register is already imported at data/registers/balears-arbres-singulars.json, so supply may be in hand already rather than needing a scout.
The Big Island, distinct from Kauai, Maui and Oahu which are already ranked. Hawaii has an Exceptional Trees law with county registries behind it, which is a register in all but name.
cities.note: Rank 43 was worked on 2026-08-17 and produced data/cities/hilo.json, five protected trees in and around the town of Hilo, three of them in Kalakaua Park. The ISLAND row stays pending on purpose: Kona, Volcano and the Hamakua coast are untouched and the register holds 30 more publishable Big Island trees, so a page called Hawaii would promise an island and deliver a town.

cities.why_pooled: Not an island but belongs in this batch for the same reason: the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi, planted 288 BC, is the oldest documented human-planted tree on earth and the single most attended individual tree anywhere. Sri Lanka is not in the out-of-focus list, which names Israel, Africa, India and Russia.
